paragraphs: Full-Stack developer. My main stack is Java and Spring on the backend, React on the front. I also wander into Computer Vision and Game Development.
I get the most out of everything I build and help people along the way. Clear communication, real commitment, quick to learn whatever the project needs.

items.description: Mitacs Globalink research internship at the PRIME lab in Moncton, Canada, on the project Quantum Machine Learning and Deep Learning in Oncology, supervised by Prof. Moulay Akhloufi. My focus is cervical cancer: I classify Pap smear images from the CRIC dataset with CNNs and Vision Transformers, then test quantum kernel-based classifiers and hybrid DL-QML pipelines to compare them against the classical baselines.

Joined as a Software Development Intern and was promoted to Junior Full-Stack Developer in January 2026. As an intern I worked with Java (Spring Boot) on the backend and React on the frontend, using Gitflow, Docker and AWS. As a junior I moved to Node.js on the BFF and React on the frontend, got much more comfortable with code quality tooling like SonarQube, mutation testing and component tests, and learned to work with BMAD, an agent-driven workflow built on custom Claude agents.

During my internship, I built a solid foundation in software architecture and development processes, utilizing agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and tools like Jira and SAP for documentation and change management.
